items.headline: Escape Room venue permitted at Blossom Hill Road plaza
items.summary: A $949,000 tenant improvement for 'The Escape Room' has been permitted at 925 Blossom Hill Rd, classified as an Assembly use commercial project.

items.headline: Chagee tea shop permitted at Saratoga Avenue address
items.summary: A $650,000 restaurant tenant improvement for 'Chagee' has been permitted at 1600 Saratoga Avenue, suite 201.
